selection_split: Calibration only. Four stratified folds with seed 20261120 screened candidate counts and OpenAPI parameter text. ToolRank hybrid with compact descriptions and five candidates passed that screen.
frozen_system: INT8 ToolRank hybrid, top five candidates. Qwen3 Reranker 0.6B on each compact operation description. Rank those candidates by yes-minus-no logits. Accept the whole request when any candidate clears the cutoff. A second arm applies the existing deployed cosine cutoff.
threshold: Choose the exact-binomial order-statistic cutoff on the original 32 calibration negatives per system, risk 0.10 and confidence 0.95 under exchangeability. Compare counts on capability_holdout.tsv once. No fine-tuning or threshold adjustment on that holdout.
limitations: A second authored catalog-specific check, with emphasis on confusing capabilities. It does not establish a deployment false-accept rate. No live invocation or generation.
